_why: M13's acceptance criterion is 'measured over 30 utterances per device, method and date recorded'. Neither existing latency gate measures this: bench/test_latency_budget.py is a live regression guard on ONE round-trip, and bench/test_latency_guard.py states outright that it is not a measurement. Without a fixed corpus, '30 utterances' is whatever the measurer happened to say, and two runs are not comparable. This file is that corpus. See docs/LATENCY-METHOD.md.
schema: batches[].device carries the D-35 budget; utterances are grouped by class so the reader can see what the number is made of rather than only the number.

conditions.room: quiet; no fans, no music, no other voice. A noise-floor sweep (M14) is a separate task and does not gate this one.
conditions.device: one device, one power state. Battery saver OFF — it changes CPU clocks and the number is meaningless across power states.
conditions.brain: the VPS brain at its normal location (tailnet), not localhost. A localhost number is a different product.
conditions.tts: the configured default, recorded by name. D-17 makes local the default; recording WHICH ran is the point of M16.
conditions.stt: the configured provider, recorded by name (D-19/D-56: local when available).
conditions.concurrent_load: no other agent, no `graphify` run, no docker build, no behavioural suite. The 2026-10-10 session saw the LLM primary's first-token behaviour swing 403ms to 2829ms on an idle box, so this is not ceremony.
conditions.edge_state: NOT parked. The MAINTENANCE file in the state root parks the edge deliberately; this measurement requires it running, which means the owner has unparked it. That is the owner's call, not this file's.

statistics.why_p95_not_mean: D-35 is a ceiling the owner experiences on the worst turn, and the milestone says p95 explicitly. A mean hides exactly the tail that makes the product feel slow.
statistics.buckets: stt / brain / tts, from the marks latency_meter already attributes. A run that misses the budget must name the bucket, or it is a number without a next action.
excluded: turns with no STT mark (a reflex turn has nothing to wait for) — the meter renders these '?'; they are counted separately, never averaged in
barge-in turns — measured under M12 / D-49 (<350 ms to halt playback), which is a different number with a different budget
statistics.repeat: three passes over the corpus per device; report the median of the three p95s, and say so. A single pass is a sample, not a measurement.
